title: Harrison ACT - Remediate the Network
current_summary: Planned access network maintenance in Harrison, ACT scheduled for 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM local time on 7 August 2026 has been cancelled by an upstream provider. No customer impact is expected. If the work is rescheduled, we will publish a new notice.
